name: venom-atlas
description: Interactive scientific atlas for venomous and poisonous organisms.

scripts.validate: tsx scripts/validate-content.ts && tsx scripts/validate-geography-sources.ts && tsx scripts/validate-media.ts && tsx scripts/validate-structures.ts
scripts.data:geography: tsx scripts/fetch-gbif-occurrences.ts && tsx scripts/generate-occurrence-maps.ts && tsx scripts/build-geography-registry.ts
scripts.build:data: tsx scripts/generate-structure-svgs.ts && tsx scripts/generate-occurrence-maps.ts && tsx scripts/generate-marine-evidence-cells.ts && tsx scripts/build-geography-registry.ts && tsx scripts/build-national-boundaries.ts && tsx scripts/build-static-json.ts && tsx scripts/build-search-index.ts && tsx scripts/build-sqlite.ts
scripts.build: pnpm validate && pnpm build:data && pnpm --filter @venom-atlas/web build && tsx scripts/prune-unverified-media.ts
